system.description: You can see and hear events without the need for Psychic Projection. To use this power, you must win a Static Mental Challenge against a variable difficulty based on your familiarity with the place you seek to view: as familiar as one's own haven (4), visited there three or four times (8), visited once (12), described in detail (18), never been there but seen a photograph (25). You may also use all other Auspex powers while using Clairvoyance.
